review.reason: The current stable official litert-converter 0.4.0 package is provenance-bound to the Google LiteRT v2.2.0 source release, but the exact stable wheel build manifest packages LiteRT MLIR/model-utils converter surfaces rather than the TensorFlow GraphDef conversion Python surface required for this admitted tflite_graph.pb. PyPI also publishes no Windows wheel for 0.4.0. The package therefore does not clear the required GraphDef-to-TFLite interface/platform gate and is stopped before installation or transitive redistribution closure.

exact_source_manifest_evidence.required_graphdef_surface: tf.compat.v1.lite.TFLiteConverter.from_frozen_graph or an exact equivalent that consumes the admitted frozen GraphDef
exact_source_manifest_evidence.source_tree_note: The same LiteRT source tree still contains TensorFlow GraphDef conversion code under tflite/, but those classic GraphDef converter surfaces are not included by the reviewed litert_converter_wheel target. Source-tree existence is not treated as package capability.

dependency_and_redistribution_gate.reason_for_early_stop: Interface and Windows package-platform requirements fail before execution. Resolving every ranged transitive dependency or redistribution notice would not make this exact stable wheel expose the missing GraphDef conversion surface.

closure.next_smallest_testable_direction: Dependency-review the current stable official TensorFlow package rather than this LiteRT converter wheel. TensorFlow 2.21.0 at tensorflow/tensorflow commit a481b10260dfdf833a1b16007eead49c1d7febf3 retains tf.compat.v1.lite.TFLiteConverter.from_frozen_graph in source and publishes CPython 3.11 Windows/Linux wheels, making it a distinct modern hypothesis from the already-closed TensorFlow 1.15/Bazel source-build route. Do not install or execute it until its exact package identities, direct and selected transitive dependencies, native components, platform support, licenses and redistribution notices clear the same fail-closed gate.
